meta.title: An uninvited vendor cannot read the technical round

words.preconditions: A fresh RFP + RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited to both rounds; both open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the “open the technical responses to score” request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to view this event.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: An uninvited vendor cannot read the technical round
